text:
incident-bot: PAGER -> High error rate on /v1/embeddings (eu-west). 12% 5xx in last 5m, customer-facing latency spikes. Paging SRE oncall.

oncall-ajay: ack. jumping in. any recent deploys?
maria: seeing a correlated spike in routing-fallbacks: a bunch of embeddings requests got routed to a chat runtime and returned 500/invalid-response. looks like variant mismatch.
oncall-ajay: can you paste a sample request/response?
maria: example: `POST /v1/embeddings` payload OK, response body: `\{"error":"incompatible input: expected embedding request but got chat schema"\}`. logs show `runtime=chat_v2` for these requests.
sam: omg, the alias for model `embed-alpha` was recently re-aliased to `open-instruct-v3` for testing — that variant is an instruct/chat runtime, not embedding-compatible.
oncall-ajay: where did that alias change come from? who ran it?
maria: change event in audit: `user:elaine-cs` at 1769998600 via admin console.
elaine-cs: I did a short test to validate a small variant change for a customer PoC, I thought aliasing would keep embedding-capable variant automatically but looks like I accidentally pointed the alias at the wrong variant. sorry.
oncall-ajay: ok we have a mis-aliased model -> embeddings routed to chat runtime -> 5xx. mitigation plan: 1) UNDO alias 2) add temporary routing rule to force embeddings to fallback-compatible variant 3) rollback any canary traffic.
sre-lead: agree. priority: restore customer traffic within next 10m, then postmortem. Maria, can you run the hotfix command to pin alias back?
maria: running: 
```
redwoodctl model alias get embed-alpha
# shows target: open-instruct-v3-chat
redwoodctl model alias set embed-alpha open-embed-v2 --force
```
returns: `200 OK, alias updated`
oncall-ajay: done? any errors?
maria: alias set succeeded. I'm also adding an explicit routing policy to prefer `open-embed-v2` for requests with `type:embedding` until the rollout is fully validated.
```
redwoodctl routing policy create --name emergency-embed-fix --match "request.type==embedding" --route "model=open-embed-v2" --priority 1000
```
policy applied.
sam: replays show error-rate dropping in eu-west from 12% -> 1.4% within 90s. customers show reduced failures.
elaine-cs: I'm owning the customer comms for the few tenants impacted; will confirm request ids and correlate.
oncall-bot: NOTE: warm reroute might cause a small token-cost bump; estimated +2% for 30m.
sre-lead: good catch. we should also inspect the alias-change workflow to prevent non-variant-compatible alias targets. Maria, log the exact alias diff and attach to incident ticket.
maria: added audit snippet to the ticket. snippet: `alias: embed-alpha, before: open-embed-v2 (hash b3f4), after: open-instruct-v3-chat (hash c7e8)`
oncall-ajay: quick check: did this affect only eu-west or other regions?
maria: most traffic hit eu-west because of route weights; edge logs show small spillover to us-east with transient 500s but below threshold.
sre-lead: escalate to platform team to add validation on alias set (schema compatibility check). @platform-team please triage.
platform-team (auto): acknowledged. will follow up.
oncall-ajay: handing off to night oncall in 30m. who is next? @sre-night?
sre-lead: night oncall is sam. Sam, I'll do a quick handoff: currently alias reset, emergency policy applied, error-rate normalized to baseline. open action items: platform validation, postmortem with root cause (UI allowed incompatible target), add a dry-run check on alias set. ETA for full root cause & RCA: EOD.
sam: got it, I'll monitor for 2 hours then rotate. noted to revoke emergency policy after 1h if stable.
elaine-cs: I'll draft client note and share in #customer-impact channel.
oncall-ajay: thanks everyone. incident resolved -> moving to monitoring. will update thread with postmortem link when ready. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT -> status: mitigated. severity: high -> reduced to low (customer impact minimal after fix).
